test_title: PYST 42: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/accbab78561398ed65dc08e38c5a112b6f06292070b7a39205404c710cbf0420.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: The lines is increased by + 1 and shifted to next place in clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16775c8353c8b261a49c86fa7fc4ad8371ee661cfe6c963e44c9fd6245e6e45b.png] 

Step II: The inner shape is shifted one place to next boxes in clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32541970594e9b738fedfaa7d01049b74f851edbb61fa97cf935e46a652ca035.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
